Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.

- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]

- On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-02-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- The indexer's incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As a follow-up to INC-2026-009, the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-19-notifier]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-04 to 2025-06-19; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-01-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-05]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]

Question: Why do notifier consumers commit offsets every five seconds?
